llm_judge_details.justification: The topology covers the main 5G core VNFs but omits PCF/NEF which are typically needed for URLLC QoS, lowering completeness. VNF types and inter‑connections follow 3GPP specifications, so correctness is high. Resource requests are modest yet reasonable for a small warehouse deployment, matching the implied scale. The defined slice (SST 3) correctly targets the URLLC robot use case, giving full slice alignment. SLA targets (8 ms latency, 1 Gbps throughput, 99.9% availability) are appropriate and meet the intent's latency requirement.
